facts.fact: APHRC's KIX-SEEDS issue brief of December 2025 lists Senegal's key education data challenges as manual, paper-based data collection and isolated digital files, with no real-time dashboards or standardised protocols; it gives no date, so the document's publication date is used, and it speaks of education data at school and sub-national level generally, not of learner records by name.

systems.tiers: Said to be comprehensive but to reach only about 20 percent of schools, for weak integration and connectivity (citing Education Profiles, 2024); nothing said of what schools do in it

systems.system: KIX-SEEDS school dashboards and mobile tools
systems.owner: ESEA Senegal, for the APHRC-led KIX-SEEDS project funded by GPE KIX
systems.tiers: Introduced in the project's selected sub-national units, with local monitoring committees; no count, and nothing said of what is entered

note: SIMEN's 'about 20 percent of schools' is given without saying what the system does, so it is a systems entry and no coverage fact. The brief also states, citing ICTworks 2023, that over one-third of public schools lack electricity and only a quarter have internet access (enabling).
